title: Heated seat not reaching temperature
shortDescription: The heated seat element on a Kohler Numi, Veil, or C3 smart toilet is not warming to the set temperature.
fullDescription:
Kohler Numi, Veil 5401 and C3 series smart toilets include a heated seat that can cycle off when GFCI trips, the thermistor fails, or the seat ribbon cable disconnects from the control PCB.

If the seat feels cool despite a medium or high temperature setting, first confirm the seat heater is enabled in the remote or app. Then verify the GFCI outlet behind the toilet has not tripped and that the power cord is fully seated.

Persistent no-heat after a reset usually indicates a failed seat heater element or thermistor and requires a seat replacement.

causes.cause: Heater disabled in settings or Eco mode
Seat ribbon cable loose under seat hinge
Failed seat heater element or thermistor

fixSteps.title: Check heat setting
fixSteps.instruction: Use remote or Kohler Konnect app to confirm seat heat is ON and not in Eco/Away mode.

fixSteps.title: Reset GFCI
fixSteps.instruction: Press reset on the GFCI outlet behind the toilet. Unplug toilet for 60 seconds then reconnect.

fixSteps.title: Reseat seat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Release seat using quick-release, inspect ribbon cable at hinge, reseat firmly.

whenToCallPro: If seat replacement is required or GFCI keeps tripping — this indicates a short.
videoSearchQuery: Kohler Numi heated seat not working

faq.q: Does Eco mode disable seat heat?
faq.a: Yes, Eco and Away modes reduce or shut off seat heating to save power.

title: Motion sensor not detecting user
shortDescription: Automatic lid open or flush does not trigger because the IR motion sensor is obstructed or misaligned.
fullDescription:
The Kohler Numi and Veil rely on an infrared proximity sensor at the front of the bowl to auto-open the lid and auto-flush. Dust, water splash on the lens, or a blocking object within 6 inches confuses the sensor.

If auto-open has stopped working but manual buttons still work, the sensor is likely dirty or has been disabled in settings. A full power cycle often re-calibrates the sensor baseline.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the IR window at the base of the seat with a soft dry cloth. Avoid ammonia cleaners.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 60 seconds, plug back in, wait for startup chime before using.

fixSteps.title: Verify app settings
fixSteps.instruction: In Kohler Konnect, confirm Auto Open and Auto Flush are enabled.

whenToCallPro: If sensor module replacement is needed.
videoSearchQuery: Kohler Numi motion sensor not working

faq.a: Yes, larger pets can cross the IR beam and open the lid.

title: Cleansing wand will not extend or retract fully
shortDescription: The bidet wand is stuck mid-travel or mispositioned and requires recalibration.
fullDescription:
Kohler C3 and Numi bidet wands use a small stepper motor with limit sensing. Mineral buildup on the wand carriage, a stalled motor, or a power interruption mid-cycle can leave the wand mispositioned.

The toilet detects this and halts bidet function until the wand is recalibrated. Use the remote's Clean/Self-Clean sequence to return the wand to home, or perform a full power cycle to force calibration on startup.

fixSteps.title: Self-clean cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold Clean on remote for 3 seconds to run self-clean which homes the wand.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug the toilet for 60 seconds to force a calibration on next power up.

fixSteps.title: Descale wand
fixSteps.instruction: With toilet unplugged, gently wipe wand with 50/50 vinegar solution. Do not pull wand by hand.

whenToCallPro: If wand motor is audibly grinding or fails to move after descale.

faq.q: Can I pull the wand back manually?
faq.a: No — this can strip the stepper motor gears.

title: UV sanitizer light not operating
shortDescription: The wand UV sterilization lamp is not illuminating during self-clean cycles.
fullDescription:
Numi 2.0 and newer Veil models include a UV-C lamp that sanitizes the cleansing wand between uses. UV bulbs have a rated life of 3-5 years and will fail gradually.

If the UV indicator on the app shows fault, or the bulb no longer glows during self-clean, the lamp module likely needs replacement. This is a sealed assembly and should be serviced by a Kohler-authorized technician.

fixSteps.title: Run self-clean
fixSteps.instruction: Trigger self-clean from remote and observe the wand area for blue UV glow.

fixSteps.title: Check app notifications
fixSteps.instruction: Open Kohler Konnect and review maintenance alerts for UV lamp replacement.

fixSteps.title: Schedule service
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Kohler service to replace UV module — not a user-serviceable part.

whenToCallPro: Always — UV module replacement requires authorized service.

faq.q: Is the toilet safe without UV?
faq.a: Yes, sanitary function continues; only the extra sterilization is offline.

title: Insufficient water pressure to bidet
shortDescription: The smart toilet detects supply pressure below 20 psi and limits bidet spray strength.
fullDescription:
Kohler smart toilets require 20-80 psi static supply pressure. A partially closed shutoff valve, clogged inlet filter screen, or household pressure drop can trigger a low-pressure warning.

Weak or missing bidet spray is the first symptom. Clean the inline filter at the supply connection and verify the angle stop is fully open before suspecting the fill valve.

fixSteps.title: Open supply valve
fixSteps.instruction: Verify the angle stop behind the toilet is turned fully counter-clockwise.

fixSteps.title: Clean inlet filter
fixSteps.instruction: Shut off water, disconnect supply line, remove and rinse the mesh filter screen at the toilet inlet.

whenToCallPro: If household pressure is confirmed low — may need booster pump.
videoSearchQuery: Kohler smart toilet low water pressure fix

faq.a: 20 to 80 psi static, with 20+ psi dynamic.

title: Water temperature sensor fault
shortDescription: The water heater thermistor is reading out of range, disabling warm-water bidet function.
fullDescription:
E01 on Kohler smart toilets indicates the thermistor monitoring the instant-heat water tank is reporting an open or shorted value. Warm bidet water is disabled as a safety precaution.

A power cycle may clear a transient fault. Persistent E01 requires replacement of the heater assembly, which should be done by a qualified technician.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug the toilet for 5 minutes then reconnect.

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: If E01 persists, contact Kohler for heater module service.

faq.a: Yes, the toilet still cleans — only comfort warmth is disabled.

title: Wand motor stall
shortDescription: The wand drive motor has stalled or is drawing abnormal current.
fullDescription:
E05 means the stepper that drives the cleansing wand cannot reach its home or extend position within the expected step count. Common causes are debris on the track, a kinked water line restricting wand travel, or a failing motor.

Try a self-clean cycle after a power reset. If E05 recurs, the seat assembly typically needs service.

causes.cause: Debris or scale on wand track
Bent or kinked wand supply tube

fixSteps.title: Run self-clean
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Clean on remote 3 seconds to exercise the wand.

fixSteps.title: Descale track
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe wand with vinegar-dampened cloth, do not force.

videoSearchQuery: Kohler smart toilet E05 wand error

faq.a: Yes — flush function is independent of the wand.

title: Remote control pairing lost
shortDescription: The RF remote is no longer paired with the toilet and buttons do not respond.
fullDescription:
Kohler smart toilet remotes use 2.4 GHz RF pairing. A battery swap, reset, or interference event can break the pair. The toilet shows E08 or simply ignores remote input.

Repair by initiating pairing mode from the side-panel button, then holding the remote's power button until the pairing LED confirms.

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Install fresh AAA batteries in the remote.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair remote
fixSteps.instruction: Press pair button on toilet side panel, then hold remote Power until LED confirms.

faq.a: Yes, the Kohler Konnect app communicates via Wi-Fi independently.

title: Numi 2.0 lost Wi-Fi connection
shortDescription: The toilet can no longer reach the Kohler Konnect cloud service.
fullDescription:
Wi-Fi loss is indicated by a dim wireless icon on the remote or an offline badge in the app. Causes include router SSID changes, new router hardware, 5 GHz-only networks (Numi is 2.4 GHz only), or cloud outages.

Re-onboard via the Kohler Konnect app: tap the device, choose Wi-Fi Settings, and follow the setup wizard to select your 2.4 GHz SSID.

fixSteps.title: Check 2.4 GHz availability
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure your router broadcasts a 2.4 GHz SSID; temporarily split bands if combined.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair in app
fixSteps.instruction: Open Konnect, Settings, Wi-Fi, follow prompts to connect to 2.4 GHz SSID.

faq.a: Yes, all local functions work without internet.

title: Lid motor obstruction
shortDescription: The automatic lid has detected resistance and halted travel.
fullDescription:
The Numi's lid uses a torque-limited motor that stops if it meets resistance, preventing pinching. Common triggers include an item on the seat, a toddler leaning on the lid, or a failing hinge gearbox.

Remove any obstruction, fully close and open the lid manually to verify free travel, then power cycle. Repeated E10 without an obvious obstruction suggests a worn hinge drive.

fixSteps.title: Clear obstruction
fixSteps.instruction: Remove anything on the seat or around the hinge.

fixSteps.title: Manual cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Gently move lid fully open and closed by hand to check for binding.

whenToCallPro: If lid binding persists after clearing obstructions.

faq.q: Can I still use the toilet?
faq.a: Yes, open the lid manually and operate normally.
